name: Apple AirPods Max - Space Gray
description: A premium over-ear headphone with a sleek matte space-gray finish. Mesh-canopy headband distributes weight evenly, while the plush cushioned ear cups swivel to fit comfortably. Aluminum ear cup housings and stainless steel telescoping arms give it a solid, high-end feel, held effortlessly with one hand.

name: Air Jordan Velocity Duffle Bag - White
description: A bold white duffle bag with black paneling along the base and a large red Jumpman graphic stitched across the front alongside the AIR JORDAN wordmark. Dual black webbing handles wrap the top, a side zip pocket adds extra storage, and the sturdy structured shape holds it upright for easy packing.

name: Classic Chronograph Watch - Brown Leather Strap
description: An elegant analog watch featuring a dark gunmetal case ringed with a textured stone-effect bezel. Three sub-dials sit on a charcoal face with silver roman numeral markers, and a rich brown leather strap with contrast stitching completes the sophisticated, budget-friendly look.

name: Apple AirPods with Charging Case - Sky Blue
description: Classic wireless earbuds in a glossy sky-blue finish, shown resting beside their matching open charging case. The compact case features a silver Apple logo on the lid, with each earbud's stem and charging contacts subtly visible, all set against a reflective blue surface.

name: Apple AirPods Pro - Mint Green
description: A pastel mint-green pair of noise-cancelling earbuds nestled in their matching glossy case, lid open to reveal the silicone-tipped buds inside. A soft green Apple logo glows on the case exterior, photographed against a calming teal backdrop.

name: Men's Travel Laptop Backpack - Charcoal Gray
description: A structured charcoal-gray backpack with a padded top handle and cushioned shoulder straps, built for daily commuting. Multiple front zip pockets, a mesh side pocket, and a metallic branded logo plate give it a clean, business-casual look suited for laptops and everyday essentials.

name: Apple AirPods Max - Sage Green
description: Floating against a dramatic black background, these sage-green over-ear headphones showcase their signature mesh headband and softly cushioned ear cups. The subtle stainless steel hinge and smooth digital crown catch the light, giving the headphones a striking, editorial presence.

name: Apple Watch Series 10 - Rose Gold & Midnight, GPS + Cellular
description: Two Apple Watches shown side by side - one in a warm rose-gold aluminum case with a soft pink sport band displaying an analog watch face, and the other in matte black with a colorful abstract watch face. Both showcase crisp always-on displays and rounded square cases.

name: Apple Watch Ultra 2 - Titanium, Orange Ocean Band
description: A rugged titanium-cased smartwatch with a vivid orange Ocean Band, built for adventure. The bright Retina display shows a data-rich dial with humidity, compass heading, wind speed, and depth readouts, alongside an orange action button for quick access to workouts and dives.

name: Men's Black Anti-Theft Travel Backpack
description: A sleek all-black backpack with a padded carry handle, contoured mesh-lined shoulder straps, and a built-in USB charging port. Dual front zip compartments and a side pocket offer organized storage, while its slim rectangular silhouette keeps it lightweight for daily commuting or travel.

name: BENYAR Men's Chronograph Watch - Blue Dial, Brown Leather
description: A sporty chronograph watch with a deep blue dial, luminous rose-gold hour markers, and a tachymeter scale ringing the bezel. Three functional sub-dials track elapsed time, and a warm tan leather strap with contrast stitching and a branded buckle rounds out the rugged, business-casual style.

name: Smart Fitness Watch - Square Display
description: A pair of square-faced smartwatches, one in black and one in cream, both displaying a bold digital clock face alongside heart rate, air quality, and step-count widgets. Soft silicone bands and slim gold-toned side buttons give the pair a clean, modern fitness-tracking look.

name: Leather Slim Briefcase Bag - Work Essentials
description: Two slim structured briefcases - one in matte black and one in navy blue - each featuring rolled top handles, a zip-around closure, and a minimalist metal logo plate. The clean saffiano-textured leather and boxy silhouette give them a polished, professional look ideal for the office.

name: 20W Fast Charger Set with USB-C to Lightning Cable
description: A compact white 20W USB-C power adapter paired with a neatly coiled charging cable secured by a cable tie. The minimalist rectangular charging head and soft-white braided-style cord give it the familiar clean, functional design of an everyday charging accessory.

name: Men's Brown High-Top Fashion Boots
description: Rugged high-top boots in a warm brown suede-look finish with a contrasting tan collar and buckle strap detail. Sturdy lace-up fronts, reinforced eyelets, and a thick white sole give these boots a tough yet stylish look, plush faux-fur lining peeking out at the ankle.

name: Air Jordan Monogram Duffle Bag - Tan
description: An elegant tan duffle bag covered in a subtle tonal Jumpman monogram print, accented with rich caramel-brown leather trim and rolled handles. A small gold Jumpman emblem sits on the front leather patch, giving this travel bag a refined, luxury-inspired finish.

name: HP 640 G5 Laptop - Core i5, 16GB RAM, 512GB SSD
description: A slim silver HP laptop shown from the rear with its lid tilted open, revealing the signature HP logo and a full row of side ports including USB, HDMI, and a memory card slot. The brushed-metal finish and compact 14-inch profile give it a clean, business-ready appearance.

name: HP Pavilion x360 Convertible Laptop
description: A sleek silver 2-in-1 convertible laptop photographed from behind, lid partly open to reveal its flexible 360-degree hinge and dark keyboard deck. The polished HP logo sits centered on the smooth aluminum-style lid, with side ports visible along the slim chassis edge.

name: Calvin Klein Men's Retro Sneakers - White & Tan
description: Retro-style running sneakers in an off-white canvas upper with tan suede overlays on the toe and heel, tied with matching tan laces. A subtle 'cK' logo sits on the side panel, and a chunky white midsole with a black stripe gives them a sporty, elevated finish.

name: Apple iPad (10th Generation) - Assorted Colors
description: Five iPads fanned out to show off the color lineup - silver, yellow, pink, and blue - each with a rounded aluminum back and a single rear camera. The front-facing tablet displays a vivid gradient wallpaper of blue, purple, red, and yellow blending across the Liquid Retina screen.

name: Apple iPhone 16 Series - Multiple Colors
description: Five iPhones stand side by side showing their glossy backs in black, white, pink, teal, and ultramarine blue. Each phone has a vertically stacked dual-camera module, a subtle Apple logo, and rounded aluminum edges that catch soft studio light.

name: Apple iPhone 17 Series - Multiple Colors
description: Held fanned out in two hands, four iPhones show off frosted-glass backs in white, sage green, deep navy, and burnt orange. The orange and navy models reveal a triple-camera housing built into a raised plateau, while the white and green models keep a sleeker dual-camera design.

name: Luxury Men's Dress Watch - Rose Gold & Leather
description: A refined rose-gold cased watch with a smoky charcoal dial, small seconds sub-dial, and a date window at three o'clock. The deep brown crocodile-embossed leather strap and softly lit moody backdrop give this timepiece a timeless, formal elegance.

name: Monogram Leather Weekender Duffle Bag - Brown
description: A rich brown canvas duffle bag stamped with a repeating card-suit monogram print, trimmed in tan leather with rolled top handles and a detachable shoulder strap. A matching luggage tag and gold-toned zip pull complete its classic weekender look.

name: Apple MacBook Pro - Space Black
description: A closed MacBook Pro in a deep matte space-black finish rests atop its original retail box, with the Apple logo etched cleanly at its center. The smooth anodized aluminum lid and slim tapered edges reflect a soft studio glow, hinting at the sleek keyboard deck underneath.

name: Wireless Lavalier Microphone Set - Dual Mic with Charging Case
description: Two compact black clip-on microphones with fuzzy foam windscreens stand beside their USB-C charging/receiver dongle. Each mic features a small screen and a green recording indicator light, built for clipping onto a collar for crisp, hands-free audio while filming.

name: Women's Laptop Tote Bag - Black with Gold Hardware
description: A structured black nylon work tote with padded top handles, an adjustable crossbody strap, and gleaming gold-tone zipper pulls. A front zip pocket and a subtle logo tab add polish, making it a sleek, professional carry for a laptop and daily essentials.

name: Apple MacBook Pro - Silver, Minimalist Setup
description: A silver MacBook Pro sits open at a slight angle against a soft white backdrop, its polished aluminum lid catching gentle light around the engraved Apple logo. The visible hinge and side ports hint at a modern, minimalist workspace setup.

name: Minimalist Stainless Steel Bracelet Watch
description: A gunmetal-gray stainless steel watch photographed mid-float against a dark gradient backdrop, showcasing its brushed link bracelet and clean sunburst dial with slim baton markers. The polished bezel and crown catch dramatic side lighting for a sleek, versatile everyday look.

name: Minimalist White Leather Sneakers
description: A clean pair of all-white leather sneakers caught mid-air, showing off their smooth panels, subtle perforated toe detailing, and chunky white sole. Matching white laces and a soft beige backdrop give this classic silhouette a timeless, versatile appeal.

name: Nike Air Force 1 High-Top - Gray & Black
description: A cool-gray high-top sneaker with black Swoosh detailing, a padded ankle strap, and chunky white-black sole, held up beside its Nike shoebox and matching pair. Crisp stitching and a ribbed collar give it a bold, streetwear-ready look.

name: Sony Alpha Mirrorless Vlogging Camera with Grip & Mic
description: A compact Sony Alpha mirrorless camera with a flip-out touchscreen and a fuzzy windscreen mic mounted on top, sitting on a handheld shooting grip with photo/movie record buttons. The all-black body and Sony branding give it a sleek, content-creator-ready design.

name: Polo Canvas Sneakers - Navy with Tan Trim
description: Casual navy canvas sneakers with contrasting tan leather eyelets and heel trim, tan laces, and an embroidered horse-and-rider Polo logo on the tongue. A thick white rubber sole finishes the classic, versatile weekend look.

name: Oraimo Power Bank - 20000mAh with Digital Display
description: A sleek black power bank with a glossy digital display showing a 100% charge readout, framed by dual USB output ports, a USB-C input port, and an auxiliary port. Its rounded, pocket-friendly shape and matte-glossy finish make it easy to grip and carry.

name: Premium Rose Gold Touchscreen Smartwatch - Metal Strap
description: A glamorous rose-gold smartwatch with a rectangular touchscreen displaying a swirling gold digital watch face and the date. The matching rose-gold metal link bracelet and polished crown give it a dressy, statement-making finish suited for both style and function.

name: Apple iPad - (PRODUCT)RED with Apple Pencil
description: A vivid red iPad lies face-down on a dark red and black surface, its single rear camera and Apple logo catching a soft glow. A white Apple Pencil rests beside it, angled diagonally across the frame for a striking, high-contrast product shot.

name: LED Ring Light with Phone Holder & Tripod Stand
description: A tall standing ring light with a glowing circular LED ring and a phone clip mounted at its center, supported by an adjustable telescoping tripod with tri-fold legs. A trailing power cord and neutral indoor setting show it ready for streaming or content shoots.

name: Smart Watch for Men and Women - Round Display, Blue Band
description: A steel-blue round smartwatch displays a swirling blue watch face with time and heart-rate readout. Its soft matching silicone band, physical side button, and smoothly contoured case make it a comfortable, unisex fitness companion.

name: Men's Navy Sport Sneakers with Orange Accent
description: Casual navy sneakers with a canvas upper, white laces, and a pop of orange at the heel tab and tongue lining, branded 'SPORT' along the side. A crisp white outsole and rounded toe give them a clean, everyday athletic-casual look.

name: Men's White & Red Sport Fashion Sneakers
description: A bold white sneaker with sweeping red accent panels, red pull tabs, and a basketball icon stitched near the toe. Chunky red-and-white ribbed laces run up a mesh tongue printed with 'FASHION' and 'SPORT', all sitting atop a thick two-tone sole for a sporty, eye-catching look.

name: Timberland 6-Inch Boots - Royal Blue & White
description: A vibrant royal-blue take on the classic Timberland boot, featuring white contrast stitching, white laces, and the signature tree logo patch on the tongue and heel. A rugged white lug sole adds a fresh, statement-making twist to the iconic silhouette, shown resting on its branded box.

name: Round Smartwatch - Matte Black, Waterproof
description: A sleek all-black round smartwatch shown from the side, its circular display facing away to highlight the slim case, side button with a red accent, and a soft matte silicone band with a metal buckle clasp. The minimalist, water-resistant design suits both workouts and daily wear.

name: Apple MacBook - Rose Gold
description: A dreamy rose-gold MacBook sits propped open at an angle, its brushed metallic lid catching a warm pink sheen around the embossed Apple logo. The matching blush-toned keyboard deck and trackpad peek out beneath, giving this laptop a soft, elegant finish.

name: Gray Canvas & Leather Weekender Duffle Bag
description: A heather-gray canvas duffle bag with a black leather base and trim, featuring tall wrapped handles, a branded gold-tone logo plate, and a double-zip bottom compartment for shoes or shoes separation. Its structured shape and neutral tones make it a practical, versatile travel companion.

name: Black and Gray Athletic Cotton Socks - 6 Pairs
description: A 6-pair bundle of cushioned athletic socks in alternating black and gray tones, featuring reinforced heel and toe panels and a ribbed arch band for a snug, supportive fit during workouts or everyday wear.

name: Intermediate Size Basketball
description: A durable composite-leather basketball with deep channel grooves for a secure grip, sized for intermediate players. Its textured surface and consistent bounce make it suited for both indoor and outdoor courts.

name: Adults Plain Cotton T-Shirt - 2 Pack
description: A simple two-pack of soft, breathable cotton t-shirts with a classic crew neckline and relaxed fit. A wardrobe staple designed for everyday comfort, easy layering, and machine-washable durability.

name: 2 Slot Toaster - White
description: A clean white two-slot toaster with wide slots for bread and bagels, adjustable browning dial, and a slide-out crumb tray. Its compact footprint fits easily on any kitchen counter.

name: 2 Piece White Dinner Plate Set
description: A pair of crisp white dinner plates with a smooth glazed finish and a subtly raised rim. Elegant enough for entertaining, yet sturdy and dishwasher-safe for everyday dining.

name: 3 Piece Non-Stick, Black Cooking Pot Set
description: A three-piece set of matte-black non-stick cooking pots with tempered glass lids and heat-resistant handles. Even heat distribution and an easy-release coating make cleanup quick and simple.

name: Cotton Oversized Sweater - Gray
description: A cozy oversized sweater in heather gray, knitted from soft cotton with dropped shoulders and ribbed cuffs and hem. Its relaxed, slouchy silhouette layers easily over leggings or jeans for a comfortable everyday look.

name: 2 Piece Luxury Towel Set - White
description: A plush two-piece set of bright white bath towels made from thick, absorbent cotton with a looped terry texture and a woven dobby border. Soft against the skin and quick-drying for everyday luxury.

name: Ultra Soft Tissue 2-Ply - 8 Boxes
description: An 8-box bundle of ultra-soft 2-ply facial tissues, gentle on the skin and designed for everyday use throughout the home, from the kitchen counter to the nightstand.

name: Women's Striped Beach Dress
description: A breezy striped beach dress in a lightweight, flowing fabric, cut for easy movement with a relaxed silhouette. Perfect as a swimsuit cover-up or a casual seaside outfit on warm days.

name: Women's Sandal Heels - Pink
description: A pair of elegant pink sandal heels with slender straps and a smooth curved heel, blending white and pink tones for a soft, feminine finish suited for both daytime and evening wear.

name: Round Sunglasses
description: A pair of retro-inspired round sunglasses with slim gold-tone metal frames and tinted lenses, offering a vintage-chic accent that pairs easily with almost any outfit.

name: Blackout Curtains Set - Beige
description: A set of soft beige blackout curtain panels woven from a dense, light-blocking fabric that also helps insulate the room. Their neutral tone and gentle drape suit bedrooms and living spaces alike.

name: Women's Summer Jean Shorts
description: A pair of classic denim shorts with a mid-rise fit, frayed hem, and front pocket detailing. A warm-weather staple built from sturdy cotton denim for everyday casual wear.

name: Electric Hot Water Kettle - White
description: A sleek white electric kettle with a stainless steel interior, cordless swivel base, and rapid boil function. An auto shut-off feature and ergonomic handle make it a safe, convenient kitchen essential.

name: Waterproof Knit Athletic Sneakers - Gray
description: A gray knit athletic sneaker built with a breathable, water-resistant upper and a cushioned foam midsole for shock absorption. Its flexible, sock-like fit makes it comfortable for running or all-day wear.

name: Straw Wide Brim Sun Hat
description: A tightly woven straw hat with a wide brim that offers ample shade from the sun. A lightweight, breathable summer accessory perfect for the beach, garden, or outdoor strolls.

name: Men's Athletic Sneaker - White
description: A clean white athletic sneaker with a breathable mesh upper, cushioned collar, and a durable rubber outsole. A versatile everyday shoe built for both casual wear and light workouts.

name: Men's Wool Sweater - Black
description: A classic black wool-blend sweater with a fitted stretch knit, ribbed crew neckline, and cuffs. Warm and lightweight, it layers easily under a jacket or stands alone as a smart-casual piece.

name: Bathroom Bath Mat 16 x 32 Inch - Grey
description: A plush gray bath mat with a soft, absorbent pile and a non-slip backing that keeps it securely in place. Sized to sit comfortably at the tub or sink edge for a cushioned step out of the shower.

name: Women's Ballet Flat - White
description: A soft white knit ballet flat with a stretchy, sock-like upper and a rounded toe. Lightweight and flexible, it slips on easily for a comfortable, minimalist everyday shoe.

name: Men's Golf Polo Shirt - Gray
description: A gray performance polo shirt with a ribbed collar, button placket, and a lightweight breathable fabric designed to wick moisture. A sharp, sporty top suited for the golf course or casual outings.

name: Laundry Detergent Tabs, 50 Loads
description: A resealable pack of 50 pre-measured laundry detergent tabs, formulated to dissolve quickly and lift stains without the mess of pouring liquid or powder detergent.

name: Sterling Silver Leaf Branch Earrings
description: A delicate pair of sterling silver earrings shaped like slender leaf branches, finished with a polished shine. An elegant, nature-inspired accessory suited for both everyday wear and special occasions.

name: Duvet Cover Set, Diamond Pattern
description: A queen-size duvet cover set woven with a subtle diamond quilted pattern in a soft gray tone. Includes matching pillow shams and a button or zipper closure for a polished, hotel-like bedroom look.

name: Women's Knit Winter Beanie - Blue
description: A cozy ribbed-knit beanie in a rich blue hue, topped with a fluffy pom-pom. Its stretchy, snug fit and thick yarn construction keep ears warm through the coldest winter days.

name: Men's Chino Pants - Beige
description: A pair of classic beige chino pants with a tailored straight leg, flat front, and durable cotton twill fabric. A versatile wardrobe staple that transitions easily from the office to the weekend.

name: Men's Navigator Sunglasses
description: A pair of sleek black navigator-style sunglasses with a slim metal frame and teardrop-shaped tinted lenses. A timeless, masculine accessory that pairs well with both casual and formal outfits.

name: Men's Brown Flat Sneakers
description: A pair of low-profile brown sneakers with a smooth upper, flat sole, and clean minimalist stitching. A comfortable, understated shoe that works well with jeans or casual trousers.

name: Non-Stick Cook Set With Lids - 4 Pieces
description: A four-piece non-stick cookware set featuring an easy-release coating, sturdy stay-cool handles, and tight-fitting lids that seal in heat and moisture for even, effortless cooking.

name: Vanity Mirror with LED Lights - Pink
description: A round vanity mirror in a soft pink frame, ringed with bright LED bulbs for even, flattering lighting. Adjustable brightness settings make it ideal for makeup application or getting ready in the morning.

name: Women's Relaxed Lounge Pants - Pink
description: A pair of soft pink lounge pants with a relaxed, wide-leg fit and an elastic drawstring waist. Made from a cozy brushed fabric, they're built for lazy days at home or a comfortable night's sleep.

name: Crystal Zirconia Stud Earrings - Pink
description: A pair of sparkling pink zirconia stud earrings set in a polished silver-tone mount, catching the light with every turn. A dainty, versatile accessory that dresses up any outfit.

name: Glass Screw Lid Containers - 3 Pieces
description: A set of three clear glass food containers with secure screw-on lids, ideal for storing leftovers, meal prepping, or organizing pantry staples. Oven, microwave, and dishwasher safe for everyday convenience.

name: Black and Silver Espresso Maker
description: A sleek black and silver espresso maker with a built-in steam wand for frothing milk, a removable drip tray, and a compact footprint that brings café-quality espresso to the home countertop.

name: Blackout Curtains Set 42 x 84-Inch - Teal
description: A pair of rich teal blackout curtain panels woven from a dense, light-blocking fabric with grommet tops for easy hanging. Their vibrant color and thermal-insulating weave add both style and function to any room.

name: Bath Towels 2 Pack - Gray, Rosewood
description: A two-pack of absorbent bath towels in complementary gray and rosewood tones, woven from soft cotton terry cloth. A cozy, quick-drying addition that adds a warm touch of color to the bathroom.

name: Athletic Skateboard Shoes - Gray
description: A gray low-top skate shoe with a padded collar, reinforced toe cap, and a flat, grippy vulcanized sole built to withstand rough boardwork while staying comfortable for all-day wear.

name: Countertop Push Blender - Black
description: A sleek black countertop blender with a push-button pulse control, sharp stainless steel blades, and a sturdy pitcher built for smoothies, sauces, and everyday food prep.

name: Men's Fleece Hoodie - Light Teal
description: A soft, brushed-fleece hoodie in a light teal shade, featuring a roomy kangaroo pocket, adjustable drawstring hood, and ribbed cuffs for a cozy, relaxed everyday fit.

name: Artistic Bowl and Plate Set - 6 Pieces
description: A six-piece dinnerware set featuring artistically glazed bowls and plates with organic, hand-painted-looking patterns. A charming mix of form and function that adds character to any table setting.

name: 2-Ply Kitchen Paper Towels - 8 Pack
description: An 8-pack of durable 2-ply paper towels, quick to absorb spills and tough enough for everyday kitchen cleanups, with a soft quilted texture that resists tearing.
